listing.name: Wipeout XL / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Unpack the v0.1.1 setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete ZIP for your system into a writable folder. Choose the Intel or Apple silicon ZIP that matches your Mac.

steps.title: Install the build tools
steps.instruction: On Windows, install Python 3. The upstream wizard downloads the build-tool pack on first rebuild. On Linux and Mac, put CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a native C/C++ compiler on PATH.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Select your own Wipeout XL (USA).cue (SCUS-94351) with all 12 referenced BIN tracks. The v0.1.1 setup wizard requires CUE and BIN files. Supply your own 524,288-byte European BIOS matching SHA-256 1faaa18fa820a0225e488d9f086296b8e6c46df739666093987ff7d8fd352c09.

steps.title: Build and add the completed player
steps.instruction: Run Wipeout_XL_Recompiled from the kit folder, with .exe on Windows. Choose Generate & rebuild. Select the completed player under build-release in Portcove and use build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Use the exact BIOS file for this kit. Its README labels that European profile SCPH-5502/5552. The Wipeout XL disc remains specific to this release.
Portcove has not verified native setup, gameplay or save compatibility.

references.title: Linux and Mac compatibility
references.instruction: The Linux setup host needs glibc 2.29 or newer, libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.26 and OpenGL. The Mac setup host and its bundled generators declare macOS 11 or newer.

references.title: Keep your working copy and data
references.instruction: Close the player before replacing the kit. Keep the working folder, original disc and BIOS, and back up the saves, settings and mods you use. Setup, replacement and backups belong to you and the upstream kit.
